name: Yoiyo Mori no Hime
source:
When her village was burned by the militarized country of Stahl, Ilza escaped into a dark forest and ends up lost. People believe that the forest, "Yoiyo Mori", is cursed, and those who take a step inside will never come out again. As she wanders inside the forest, Ilza loses consciousness and is taken into a certain mansion—where she finds seven men who bear resentment towards Stahl. They are waiting for a chance to take revenge on the country, and her life with them has just begun…

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140911003034/http://otome-jikan.net/2014/01/yoiyomori-no-hime/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
translation:
当她的村庄被斯塔尔的军事国家烧毁时，伊尔扎逃进了一片黑暗的森林，最终迷路了。人们相信森林“Yiyo Mori”受到了诅咒，踏入其中的人将永远不会再出来。当伊尔扎在森林里徘徊时，她失去了知觉，被带进了一座宅邸，在那里她发现了七个对斯塔尔怀有怨恨的男人。他们正在等待报国的机会，而她与他们的生活才刚刚开始……

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140911003034/http://otome-jikan.net/2014/01/yoiyomori-no-hime/]乙女事件[/url]]
